summary: The supervisor's tip-claim handoff is decoded twice under two disagreeing predicates, so a present-but-unusable value runs a tick with no claim on the ref it moves
acceptance: one decode answers both the pid a tick treats as its own claim and whether it acquires one, and a handoff value that names no pid refuses at the point of detection rather than proceeding
tests: a tick refuses when the supervisor tip-claim handoff carries a value that names no pid
notes: Verified this tick: `src/cli.ts:1000` reads `FLUME_TIP_CLAIM_HELD` by truthiness, `:1232` by `!== undefined`. An empty value skips `acquireTipClaim` *and* sets `ownTipClaimPid` to this process's own pid — a bare tick moving the ref with no claim on it. A non-numeric value is `NaN` at `:1001`, and `holder === ownTipClaimPid` (`src/tipVerify.ts:44`) never matches it, so a loop child reads its own supervisor's claim as foreign. Re-filed after the 95ed6b52 revert.
